description: This file contains utility functions for managing FastAPI dependencies, including dependency resolution, parameter analysis, and request body handling. It integrates with Starlette and Pydantic to facilitate dependency injection, request parsing, and validation within FastAPI applications.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class holding details about a parameter, including its type annotation, dependencies, and associated model field.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including values, errors, background tasks, response, and cache.

methods.name: ensure_multipart_is_installed
methods.description: Checks if 'python-multipart' is installed and correctly configured, raising RuntimeError if not.

methods.name: get_parameterless_sub_dependant
methods.description: Creates a Dependant for a parameterless dependency, extracting OAuth scopes if applicable.

methods.name: get_flat_dependant
methods.description: Flattens nested dependencies into a single Dependant, optionally skipping repeats.

methods.name: _get_flat_fields_from_params
methods.description: Extracts fields from a model if only one field is present and it's a BaseModel.

methods.name: get_flat_params
methods.description: Returns a flattened list of all path, query, header, and cookie parameters from a Dependant.

methods.name: _get_signature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a callable, with eval_str=True if Python >= 3.10.

methods.name: get_typed_signature
methods.description: Returns a signature with annotated parameters, evaluating forward references.

methods.name: get_typed_annotation
methods.description: Evaluates and returns a possibly string-based annotation, resolving forward references.

methods.name: get_typed_return_annotation
methods.description: Retrieves and evaluates the return annotation of a callable.

methods.name: get_dependant
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for a given path, callable, and scopes, analyzing parameters.

methods.name: add_non_field_param_to_dependency
methods.description: Assigns special parameter names for non-field dependencies like Request, WebSocket, etc.

methods.name: analyze_param
methods.description: Analyzes a parameter's annotation, default value, and determines its ModelField, dependencies, and type.

methods.name: add_param_to_fields
methods.description: Adds a ModelField to the appropriate list in a Dependant based on its 'in' parameter.

methods.name: _solve_generator
methods.description: Handles execution of generator dependencies within an async context manager.

methods.name: solve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given Dependant, including nested dependencies, request parsing, and context management.

methods.name: _validate_value_with_model_field
methods.description: Validates a value against a Pydantic ModelField, returning the validated value and errors.

methods.name: _get_multidict_value
methods.description: Extracts a value from a multidict-like structure, considering sequence fields and defaults.

methods.name: request_params_to_args
methods.description: Converts request parameters (query, headers, cookies) into a dict of arguments for dependency injection.

methods.name: is_union_of_base_models
methods.description: Checks if a type is a Union of only BaseModel subclasses.

methods.name: _should_embed_body_fields
methods.description: Determines if body fields should be embedded based on their structure and annotations.

methods.name: _extract_form_body
methods.description: Extracts and reads form data fields asynchronously, handling file uploads.

methods.name: request_body_to_args
methods.description: Parses and validates request body data into dependency arguments.

methods.name: get_body_field
methods.description: Creates a combined ModelField representing the request body, optionally embedding fields.

methods.name: get_validation_alias
methods.description: Returns the alias used for validation, defaulting to the field's alias.
